notes.title: Bugfix patch 1.0.1 to address a couple small problems
notes.notes:
Just patching a few small things we noticed were not working right while doing a sanity check competition this afternoon.

BUXFIXES: 
-The medal counts have been corrected, previously silver and bronze medals were not counted correctly. 
-Heads are now correctly colored in the spectator's (monitor) view.. Now that I noticed it that will forever bug me in the release trailer!! arrrgg... oh well...
-Added an image of a touch controller alongside the Vive wand to the "unpause dialog" on the handheld scorecard.

notes.title: Coming in patch 0.3
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for your continued support for World VR Competition.  I wanted to leave a quick note letting you all know what we are working on.

Firstly we are working on a new avatar system.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25878770/99cfbd667f42b70a78b56e0b3eca474294340dba.jpg

Obviously there won't be any trademarked images on the final product, but this will be a huge improvement over the current, generally criticized, models.  We hope to have this new system ready for 0.3's release!

While there really aren't a ton of bugs to correct, this is still our top priority along with balancing the current events and making sure they are as fun as possible.

We are also working on a new javelin event which should be lots of fun once it's finished!  Hopefully we will be introducing a flying event soon also, but that will require more testing and it likely won't be included in the full competition game mode since it likely will make many people sick, so it will be optional only for practice and custom competitions.

Again, if you have any questions, feedback, or concerns please let me know!

Thank you all!
Mike and the entire MT_Worlds Team

notes.title: Content patch 0.2 and dev update
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/hYoZWbp6zo8

Hi all, we have just released our first content patch for World VR Competition, this includes a few new features mostly aimed at further improving the already awesome local multiplayer mode!  Check out the short video we created on the patch:

FEATURES:
-NEW spectator scoreboard so that everyone waiting their turn will be able to see exactly what how the scores, standings, and records are shaping up.
-NEW spectator camera will now attach to the sniper bullets and the arrows to make watching these events more exciting.
-NEW full leaderboard showing not only your position in the world record rankings, but also the people above and below you. 

IMPROVEMENTS:
-Sniper rifle is now always held and does not require reloading any longer.
-Shotgun pump action is shorter, should be a bit easier to reload now.
-Trap Shooting is now easier on easy and medium with larger clay pigeons in both, and bullets are faster to make the game slightly easier on all levels.

BUGFIXES: 
-Hitting the projectiles in Energy Swords with two blades will no longer yield you two points.
-Fixed world records being mixed up between events very randomly.
-Improved sights on revolvers for easier aiming in the dual pistols game.
-Fixed some erroneous pregame tutorials

notes.title: Coming in patch 0.2, and Thank you!
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has purchased our game so far!  We truly appreciate it and hope you are enjoying yourselves.  If you notice bugs or would like to see certain improvements or changes, please post them in discussions or here and we will do our best to take care of these for you.

Looking forward to patch 0.2 which will be the first patch to add content and features to the game.  We plan to release this patch by August 19th, these are the things we have planned:

-We will be adding a scoreboard to the spectator camera.  In the most recent play test I did with 4 other friends, everyone had a blast, but they were not able to see the scores and records while others play.  This is a big problem in my opinion.  We will be adding a scoreboard to the spectator view (meant to be shown on a monitor/TV to the rest of the players waiting their turns).  This will include current game scores for all players, records (Personal Best, Computer Record, and World Record), and current medal counts (gold, silver, bronze, overall medal points).  This will make party mode even more fun then it is now!

-"Practice all Events" mode.  Instead of having to back out of practice after every game, simply use practice all events and run through them all on your own.

-Removing need to reload and grip the sniper rifle, it will automatically load itself now and you will always have it in both hands.

-Changing / improving sights on pistols in dual pistols game.  They are a bit hard to see right now.

-Arrows will disappear as you use them in archery, showing you how many shots you have left.

-Adjusting energy blade and boxing difficulty levels.

Thank you!
-Mike Stankiewicz
MT Worlds

notes.title: Bugfix patch 0.1.1 Released 8-6-2016
notes.notes:
BUGFIXES:
-The tutorial / pregame scorecard will now show up before every game, not just the first.
-The tutorials in the scorecards have been updated to show all the correct information, new audio and visuals.

CHANGES:
-The orange projectile was removed from energy blades to reduce complexity.
-The arrows in Sword & Shield are now much easier to see.

Many more bugfixes and a few new features to come in the following days.  

Thank you all!
